author: creativeleadscommunity
title: Line Art Finishing Artist for Graphic Novel
content: Graphic novel production seeks Line Art Finishing Artist (Remote). Work on finishing and refining line art, completing illustrated pages, and adding shadows, lighting, and final details under the Lead Artist’s direction. Requires strong character drawing and anatomy skills, knowledge of perspective and movement, clean linework, and the ability to match an established visual style. Experience with comics, sequential art, or illustrated narratives is a plus. Interested? https://creativeleadscommunity.com Lead Id: 18171

title: Hiring Character Artist for Legends of Orisha
content: WE'RE HIRING! We're looking for a Character Artist to join the team working on Legends of Orisha: Blood and Water. Experience with MetaHuman, realistic 4C hair, African hairstyles, and character materials is a big plus. Remote. Long-term collaboration. Interested? Find the full job description and application details through the link in our bio.

author: emilygraceillustration
title: Storyboard Artist Wanted for Animatic
content: STORYBOARD ARTIST WANTED! I'm looking for a talented freelance storyboard artist to collaborate on a short proof-of-concept animatic for an original animated action-adventure series. I'm particularly keen to hear from artists who specialise in dynamic action sequences, cinematic composition and strong character moments. This is a paid opportunity for a small, creator-led project. If you're interested, or know someone who might be a great fit, please get in touch or tag them below. Please share your portfolio/reel and rates via DM.

author: aionlabo
title: Atomic Cartoons seeks CG Storyboard Artist
content: Atomic Cartoons seeks a CG Storyboard Artist for an ongoing animated series. Applicants need 2+ years' relevant CG storyboarding experience, Storyboard Pro skills and current legal eligibility to work in Canada. Documented BC residency as of 31 December 2025 is required. Remote work is available within British Columbia; Vancouver and Lower Mainland artists may choose hybrid or studio work. CAD1,500–1,800 per week. No application deadline or contract duration stated. Apply through the employer's form. https://www.aionlabo.com/en/post/atomic-cartoons-cg-storyboard-artist-8013727003-2026-en
